title: Rededication of the Temple by Judas Maccabaeus (25 Chislev 148 SE, 165/164 BC)
summary: After three years of desolation under Antiochus IV, Judas Maccabaeus's party built a new altar and resumed the offerings on 25 Chislev of the Seleucid year 148, instituting the eight-day festival later called Dedication or Lights.
external_reason: External historical event recorded in 1 Maccabees 4:52–59 and Josephus, Ant. 12.7.6–7; its festival is mentioned in John 10:22. Proposed by many interpreters as the end-point of Daniel 8:14.

mentions.notes: The Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem, commemorating this event.

scripture_extraction.reason: External event; 1 Maccabees is outside the 66-book index; John 10 not yet extracted.
